### Overview
This script generates chart for data prepared in 1DP_00_visium.Rmd and spatial transcriptomics dataset originally published by Zucha et al. (2024) (https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2404203121).


```{r}
spatial_seurat <- readRDS("data/spatial_seurat_1DP_13_nygen.rds")#download dataset
```

#Spatial visualisation for Aldh1l1
```{r}
# Compute global min/max for Aldh1l1 across all spots
aldh_values <- FetchData(spatial_seurat, vars = "Aldh1l1")
global_min <- floor(min(aldh_values$Aldh1l1, na.rm = TRUE))
global_max <- ceiling(max(aldh_values$Aldh1l1, na.rm = TRUE))

plots <- list()
image_names_list <- c("Ctrl", "7DPI")

for (img in image_names_list) {
  # 1. Generate the base plot using the actual slot name ("Ctrl" or "7DPI")
  p <- make_transcript_plot(spatial_seurat, img, "Aldh1l1", rotation_degrees = 90)
  
  # 2. FIXED: If the slot is 7DPI, dynamically rename its title display to MCAO
  if (img == "7DPI") {
    p <- p + labs(title = "MCAO")
  }
  
  plots[[img]] <- p
}

# Define a manual label with a coordinate system
row_label <- ggplot() + 
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, 
           label = "Aldh1l1", 
           angle = 90, 
           size = 2.1,          
           fontface = "italic") + 
  theme_void() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1)) + 
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

# Combine the panels smoothly
final_plot <- (row_label | wrap_plots(plots[image_names_list], ncol = 2)) + 
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(0.15, 1), 
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = get_label("pub_spatial")
  ) & 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,              
      size = 6,
      margin = margin(b = 4)    
    )
  )

final_plot

# Save canvas
ggsave(
  filename = "results/05_visium/2V_05_spatial_Aldh1l1.tiff",
  plot = final_plot,
  device = "tiff",
  width = 3.5, 
  height = 2.5, 
  units = "cm",
  bg = "white",
  dpi = 600,            
  compression = "lzw"
)
```

#Spatial visualisation for Gfap
```{r}
# Compute global min/max for Aldh1l1 across all spots
aldh_values <- FetchData(spatial_seurat, vars = "Gfap")
global_min <- floor(min(aldh_values$Gfap, na.rm = TRUE))
global_max <- ceiling(max(aldh_values$Gfap, na.rm = TRUE))

plots <- list()
image_names_list <- c("Ctrl","7DPI")

for (img in image_names_list) {
  # Use 90 for 90 degrees clockwise
  plots[[img]] <- make_transcript_plot(spatial_seurat, img, "Gfap", rotation_degrees = 90)
}

# Define a manual label with a coordinate system
row_label <- ggplot() + 
  # annotate places the text at a specific (x, y) point
  # Adjust 'y' to move it up or down (0 is center, positive is up, negative is down)
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, 
           label = "Gfap", 
           angle = 90, 
           size = 2.1,          # size 2.1 in annotate is approx size 6 in element_text
           fontface = "italic") + 
  theme_void() +
  # This creates a 'box' from -1 to 1. 
  # You can now move the label precisely by changing y in annotate above.
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1)) + 
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

# The rest of your combination code stays the same
final_plot <- (row_label | wrap_plots(plots[image_names_list], ncol = 2)) + 
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(0.15, 1), 
    guides = "collect"
  ) +
  # --- THE FIX: Add a shared global title ---
  plot_annotation(
    title = get_label("pub_spatial")
  ) & 
  # Using the & operator applies theme styling across the entire patchwork canvas
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,              # Center it across the whole image
      size = 6,
      margin = margin(b = 4)    # Add a tiny gap between title and plots
    )
  )

final_plot

ggsave(
  filename = "results/05_visium/2V_00_spatial_Gfap.tiff",
  plot = final_plot,
  device = "tiff",
  width = 3.5, 
  height = 2.5, 
  units = "cm",
  bg = "white",
  dpi = 600,            
  compression = "lzw"
)
```


```{r}
cell_summary <- readRDS("ws/05_visium/1DP_05_Gfap_summary_visium.rds")
cell_summary$Percent_Integer <- round(cell_summary$Percent_Gene_Positive)
```
#Bar plot for Aldh1l1+ and Gfap-high+ spots
```{r}
# Define pairwise comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  #c("Ctrl", "1DPI"),
  #c("Ctrl", "3DPI"),
  c("Ctrl", "7DPI")
)

# Run Fisher test for each comparison
pval_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(comparisons, function(pair) {
  group1 <- pair[1]
  group2 <- pair[2]

  data1 <- cell_summary[cell_summary$sample == group1, ]
  data2 <- cell_summary[cell_summary$sample == group2, ]

  contingency_table <- matrix(c(
    data1$High_Expressing_Cells, data1$Total_Cells - data1$High_Expressing_Cells,
    data2$High_Expressing_Cells, data2$Total_Cells - data2$High_Expressing_Cells
  ), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

  p <- fisher.test(contingency_table)$p.value

  data.frame(group1 = group1, group2 = group2, p.value = p)
}))

# Adjust p-values
pval_df$p.adj <- p.adjust(pval_df$p.value, method = "BH")

# Add significance stars
pval_df$p.adj.signif <- sapply(pval_df$p.adj, function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("ns")
})

# Add y positions for each bracket
pval_df$y.position <- c(420)

# --- FIXED FOR BRACKET MATCHING ---
# If your x-axis labels are renamed to MCAO, the significance bracket 
# needs to target "MCAO" instead of "7DPI" to align perfectly.
pval_df$group2[pval_df$group2 == "7DPI"] <- "MCAO"


# ==========================================
# STEP 2: PLOT GENERATION
# ==========================================
cell_summary_filtered <- cell_summary[cell_summary$sample %in% c("Ctrl", "7DPI"), ]

plots[["bar_splot_spatial"]] <- ggplot(cell_summary_filtered, aes(x = sample, y = Total_Cells)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = "Aldh1l1+"), stat = "identity", color = col_list[["borders"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = High_Expressing_Cells, fill = "Gfap-high+"),
           stat = "identity", color = col_list[["borders"]], linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(y = High_Expressing_Cells + 10, label = paste0(Percent_Integer, "%")),
            size = 2, vjust = 0) +

  # Significance brackets from Fisher test (Uncomment when ready)
  # stat_pvalue_manual(
  #   pval_df,
  #   label = "p.adj.signif",
  #   tip.length = 0.01,
  #   size = 1.5
  # ) +

  theme_mk_title +
  labs(title = get_label("pub_spatial"), y = "Number of spots", fill = "Spots") +
  remove_grid +
  
  # --- FIXED: Remap 7DPI column label to MCAO on the axis display ---
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Ctrl" = "Ctrl", "7DPI" = "MCAO")) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 310, vjust = 0.1, hjust = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = col_list[["bar_plot_visium"]],
    labels = c(
      "Aldh1l1+" = get_label("Aldh1l1+"), 
      "Gfap-high+" = get_label("Gfap_high+")
    )                  
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 520))

plots[["bar_splot_spatial"]]

#save
ggsave(
  filename = "results/05_visium/2V_05_spatial_barplot.tiff",
  plot = plots[["bar_splot_spatial"]],
  device = "tiff",
  width = 4, 
  height = 4, 
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 600,            
  compression = "lzw", 
  bg = "white"
)
```
